general.llamamiento_contexto_manual: Enter the reference and version of the audited case, or retrieve an operation using its original details.
general.llamamiento_contexto_enlazado: Audited case details. The server checks that they are still valid.
general.llamamiento_replay_registrada_localmente: Local record retrieved · Delivery not evidenced
general.llamamiento_clave_ayuda: Keep this key and all visible fields before submitting. To retrieve the operation after a restart, enter exactly the same details: do not prepare a new key.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_seleccion: The candidate call will be requested in the order established by the source for this case at version {version}. If you have already submitted these same details, the result will be retrieved without creating another candidate call.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_comunicacion: This communication will be recorded locally at version {version} and linked to the selection receipt shown. This does not evidence dispatch, delivery, a response period or acceptance by the candidate.
general.llamamiento_prueba_ayuda: References retrieved from the actual selection receipt. They are not entered manually and do not evidence delivery. Keep the original key to retrieve a previous communication.
general.llamamiento_espera_seleccion: Start or retrieve the selection first to obtain its references. You do not need to invent or transcribe them.
general.llamamiento_enviando: Recording. Keep the details and wait for the response.
general.llamamiento_sin_recibo: There is no confirmed result yet.
general.llamamiento_error: The result could not be confirmed. The attempted operation details remain on screen; do not prepare another key.
general.llamamiento_validacion: Check the references, version and operation key.
general.llamamiento_rechazada: Request rejected. Check the fields before confirming again.
general.llamamiento_conflicto: This operation requires server review. Do not repeat it or change the key to force it through.
general.llamamiento_contenido_respuesta_en_confl: A different reply already exists for this call. Open the case and review its record before continuing.
general.llamamiento_consulta_sin_contexto: The notice is not yet available for looking up its reply.
general.llamamiento_consulta_cargando: Checking whether a reply is already recorded. Wait before recording another one.
general.llamamiento_consulta_confirmada: Reply recorded by the Department. View its receipt; this record does not resolve the call or prove custody of the email.
general.llamamiento_consulta_ausente: No reply can be viewed with this identity. If you have the email, ask HR to check access before continuing.
general.llamamiento_consulta_ausente_sin_anteced: No reply can be viewed with this identity. Open the call and ask HR to check access before continuing.
general.llamamiento_consulta_registrada_sin_reci: Reply recorded by the Department; its receipt is not available for this notice.
general.llamamiento_consulta_sin_respuesta_verif: The authorised list showed no reply when checked. If you have the email, you may record the declaration; the server will check again.
general.llamamiento_consulta_intento_no_confirma: An earlier declaration has no confirmed receipt. You may check another call, but do not record another reply until HR reviews it.
general.llamamiento_consulta_denegado: You cannot view this reply. Its details and the form have been hidden. Ask HR to review your access.
general.llamamiento_consulta_error: We could not check whether a reply already exists. Retry the lookup before recording another one.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_sin_contexto: Open a case to look up its calls.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_cargando: Checking all calls. Wait before recording a reply.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_lista: Choose the call whose reply you want to check.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_vacia: No candidate call notices are recorded for this case.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_denegado: You cannot view these calls. The options and form have been hidden.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_error: The complete call list could not be checked. Retry the lookup before recording a reply.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_revisar_tras_: This declaration's outcome has not been confirmed. Check the call list again before continuing.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_intento_no_co: This screen keeps the declaration without a receipt while it remains open. Ask HR before sending another one.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_respuesta_pen: Reply pending in the checked list
general.llamamiento_respuesta_resultado_incierto: The record could not be confirmed. This screen keeps the submitted reply; retry it here with the same details.
general.llamamiento_recuperacion: Continue or retrieve a candidate call
general.llamamiento_recibo_seleccion_ayuda: The receipt confirms the selection. It does not disclose the candidate's identity or position, or their acceptance.
general.llamamiento_recibo_comunicacion_ayuda: Communication recorded. This receipt does not evidence that an actual email was sent.
general.llamamiento_opcion_aceptacion_despues: You can then prepare the appointment proposal.
general.llamamiento_opcion_renuncia_despues: You can then call the next person in the pool.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_renuncia: Decision to decline stated in the email
general.llamamiento_respuesta_ayuda: HR declares the response received and its email reference. The original remains in the email system. This record does not verify origin, signature or custody, does not evidence dispatch or delivery, and does not change the candidature or case.
general.llamamiento_correo_ref: Reference of the email kept in your system
general.llamamiento_correo_sha256: Declared SHA-256 fingerprint of the email
general.llamamiento_recibida_en: Date and time the reply arrived (Madrid)
general.llamamiento_correo_ayuda: This is the proof of the reply: attach the email exactly as received (.eml file, up to 2 MB). It is checked on this computer and its content is not stored.
general.llamamiento_correo_calculando: Calculating the email fingerprint locally. Wait before confirming.
general.llamamiento_correo_calculado: Fingerprint calculated locally. Check the details and confirm that the declaration should be recorded.
general.llamamiento_correo_huella_conservada: Email checked on this device; its content is not stored.
general.llamamiento_correo_error: The fingerprint could not be calculated. Select a non-empty .eml file of up to 2 MiB and check that WebCrypto is available. No content has been sent.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_respuesta: You are about to record: {respuesta}. Email reference: {correo}. Received on: {recibida}. VEC keeps its fingerprint, but not the email or evidence of custody. HR must review the acceptance or withdrawal afterwards.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_validacion: Select a reply, enter the Madrid date and time and the email reference. Attach an .eml file of up to 2 MB.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_hora_no_univoca: That Madrid time did not occur or occurred twice during a clock change. Check the email timestamp and ask IT for help.
general.llamamiento_recibo_respuesta_ayuda: The declared response, reference and fingerprint have been recorded. The original remains in the email system; VEC does not retain its content or verify origin, signature or custody. This does not evidence dispatch or delivery, resolve acceptance or withdrawal, or change the candidature or case version.
general.llamamiento_resultado_sucesor_renuncia_p: The continuation intention is pending. View the receipt; no further opening is available on this screen yet.
general.llamamiento_resultado_declaracion_no_dis: No declaration has been recorded yet.
general.llamamiento_resultado_circuito_pendiente: Pending explicit review and resolution by HR.
general.llamamiento_resultado_vencimiento_no_eva: No response period has started: effective contact is missing. An email notice does not start the period.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_resoluci: Review the declaration and request a resolution; it is not resolved automatically.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_continua: Retrieve or open one continuation from the pending intention.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_aviso: Record the local notice to the successor; it is not sent and does not start a response period.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_propuest: Review and record the proposal; there is no appointment or signature.
The proposal has been recorded; refresh the case to view its status.
general.llamamiento_resultado_limite: A declaration is not a resolution. Expiry cannot be assessed until a governed start point and policy are available.
general.llamamiento_replay_registrada_por_rrhh: Same declaration retrieved, without a new record
general.llamamiento_respuesta_solicitada: Response for which a resolution is requested
general.llamamiento_prueba_respuesta_ref: Previous supporting evidence for the HR declaration
general.llamamiento_revision_respuesta_rrhh: I have checked the response and its supporting evidence
general.llamamiento_revision_plazo_rrhh: I record that the required manual review has taken place; this does not assess the start, response period or expiry
general.llamamiento_validacion_manual_desarrollo: Manual validation does not evidence email delivery or assess a statutory response period.
general.llamamiento_resolucion_ayuda: The server is asked to record the manual review of the supporting evidence and check HR permission. The recorded declaration does not itself resolve acceptance or withdrawal. Expiry is not assessed because a governed start point and policy are missing. Email dispatch, delivery, signature and custody are not evidenced. No further EML file is provided.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_resolucion: The following will be requested: {respuesta}. Your manual review of the response and supporting evidence {justificante} will be recorded under criterion {criterio} for this case and communication at version {version}. The server requires its own permission and must retain the validation before confirming Temporary Staff Requests and the recruitment pool. Expiry is not assessed because a governed start point and policy are missing. There is no confirmed resolution until the result is received, and another person is not selected automatically. This does not evidence email delivery or approval of the process by the operator.
general.llamamiento_solicitando_resolucion: Requesting resolution. Please wait; there is no confirmed resolution yet.
general.llamamiento_resolucion_validacion: Retrieve the supporting evidence for a declaration of acceptance or withdrawal and use a resolution key distinct from the previous operations. Tick both manual checks. Do not change the preceding records or attempt to assess expiry.
general.llamamiento_validacion_respuesta_pendien: Pending manual review by HR. Expiry cannot be assessed and the resolution has not been confirmed.
general.llamamiento_reintentar_resolucion: Request again using the same details
general.llamamiento_recibo_resolucion_ayuda: The server confirms the manual record in Temporary Staff Requests and the recruitment pool. This does not evidence email delivery, assess expiry, or evidence appointment or commencement of employment.
general.llamamiento_intencion_siguiente_ayuda: Only the pending intention has been recorded. No other person has been selected or notified.
general.llamamiento_siguiente: Continue with the next candidate call
general.llamamiento_siguiente_ayuda: Previous records of the confirmed withdrawal or lack of response and its pending intention. You may only prepare or retrieve the key for this operation. Another person is not selected automatically, and dispatch, delivery or acceptance is not evidenced.
general.llamamiento_continuar: Review and open the next candidate call
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_siguiente: One new candidate call will be opened after the withdrawal, linked to resolution {resolucion} and intention {intencion} for this case. The server applies the order and its own permissions. A retry using the same key retrieves the same operation. This does not evidence that a notice was sent, delivered or accepted.
general.llamamiento_siguiente_validacion: Retrieve the confirmed withdrawal or lack of response with a pending intention and use a continuation key distinct from the previous keys. Do not change the references or replace a key that has already been submitted.
general.llamamiento_recibo_siguiente_ayuda: This fifth operation confirms continuation after the withdrawal. It does not evidence that a notice was sent, delivered or accepted. Previous receipts are retained; the local notice to the successor requires separate confirmation and is not recorded automatically.
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente: Record local notice to the next candidate
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente_ayuda: Previous record of the confirmed continuation receipt. You may only prepare or retrieve a dedicated key distinct from the previous operations. This is a local notice: no email is sent and no response period starts. Once confirmed, step 7 permits a response to be declared manually without resolving it.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_comunicacion_si: A local notice to the successor will be recorded at version {version}, linked to continuation receipt {antecedente}. The server verifies that preceding record and its permissions. This does not evidence dispatch, delivery, the start of a response period or acceptance; previous receipts remain unchanged. Keep this key to retrieve the same notice.
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente_valid: Retrieve the confirmed continuation and use a dedicated key for the notice to the successor, distinct from the previous keys. Do not change the preceding records or replace a key that has already been submitted.
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente_recib: Local notice to successor recorded · Not sent
general.llamamiento_recibo_comunicacion_siguient: Local record linked to the continuation receipt. This does not evidence dispatch or delivery and does not start a response period. Step 7 permits a response from the successor to be declared manually, without a resolution. The first communication and previous receipts are retained.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_siguiente_ayuda: HR declares the response received from the successor following the confirmed local notice. The original remains in the email system; only the declared reference and fingerprint are retained. This does not verify origin, signature or custody, evidence delivery or a statutory response period, resolve acceptance or withdrawal, or alter the previous resolution.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_siguiente_validaci: Check the next candidate's reply, email reference and Madrid date and time. Attach the .eml file to calculate its fingerprint.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_siguiente_recibo: Successor response declaration recorded · No resolution
general.llamamiento_recibo_respuesta_siguiente_a: The HR declaration and the successor email reference and fingerprint have been recorded. The content is not retained; this does not evidence origin, signature, custody, delivery or a response period. It does not resolve acceptance or withdrawal or progress the case, and it retains previous receipts and the previous resolution.
general.llamamiento_resolucion_siguiente: Review and resolve the next candidate's reply
general.llamamiento_resolucion_siguiente_ayuda: Previous record of the successor's confirmed supporting evidence, rather than the first declaration. Explicitly review the response and response period and confirm using a dedicated key distinct from all previous keys. The server checks the actual opening in the recruitment pool and its permissions; there is no resolution until the result is received. No further EML file, email dispatch, statutory response period or signature is provided. Once acceptance is confirmed, you can review the proposal in the shared form; it is not recorded automatically and another candidate call is not opened.
general.llamamiento_recibo_resolucion_siguiente_: The server confirms the successor record in Temporary Staff Requests and the recruitment pool. The seven previous receipts are retained. This does not evidence delivery, a statutory response period, signature, appointment or commencement of employment. A pending intention does not open another candidate call, and a proposal is not recorded automatically.
general.llamamiento_intencion_siguiente_historic: Historic withdrawal receipt: the intention was pending when it was recorded. The fifth operation receipt confirms its subsequent continuation without changing this receipt.
general.llamamiento_intencion_despachada: Continuation confirmed · Does not evidence notice dispatch
general.llamamiento_propuesta_pantalla_ayuda: Confirmed acceptance permits the proposal to be reviewed and recorded using the following action.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_pantalla_limite: This does not submit documents, evidence delivery, sign or appoint the candidate.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_ayuda: Previous record of the confirmed acceptance by the original candidate or successor, the audited case at version 6 and public publications. You may only prepare or retrieve a dedicated key distinct from all previous operations. Before saving, the server checks acceptance, version and publications. Previous receipts are retained. This is not a signed appointment or a statutory exemption from signature.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_no_disponible: Formalisation publications are unavailable. Submission is not permitted. You may load them again without replacing references or fingerprints.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_pendiente: Publications available. Review them before requesting that the proposal be recorded.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_validacion: Retrieve a confirmed acceptance for the audited case at version 6 and use a dedicated key distinct from the previous keys. Do not change the preceding records or publications.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_propuesta: An appointment proposal will be recorded for this case, candidate call {llamamiento}, acceptance resolution {resolucion} and expected version {version}. The type and template identify an unsigned draft without data; the policy and plan leave the signatories and process pending. This does not generate documents, order a signature or evidence an appointment. Keep the key to retrieve the same receipt.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_actualizando: Receipt verified. Updating the case and available documents.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_actualizacion_pend: Receipt verified. The case update is still pending; do not repeat the proposal.
general.llamamiento_recibo_propuesta_ayuda: Local proposal receipt, case version and UTC date. This does not evidence a generated document, signature, external registration, download, effective appointment or commencement of employment. Acceptance receipts are retained.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_ayuda: Manual validation is not a legal signature, does not produce administrative effect and does not evidence document custody.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_revision: I have expressly reviewed the proposal and resolution document.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_limites: Official signature: no. Administrative effect: no. Document custody: no.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_documento_resol: Resolution document checked by the server
general.resolucion_formalizacion_validacion: Check the number, date, reason and both confirmations.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_cancelada: Action cancelled; you may correct the details.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_recuperacion_ca: Retrieval cancelled; the uncertain request remains unchanged.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_rechazada: You may correct the details and submit again.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_incierta: Uncertain outcome: keep the details and retry to retrieve the receipt.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_consu: There is a conflict. Checking the case record; the request and its key remain unchanged.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_histo: Historic receipt retrieved from the case. This does not confirm that it matches the conflicting request; no further resolution has been submitted.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_sin_r: The query returns no receipt. The key may already have been used: the details remain locked and you may only retry the exact request.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_lectu: The case receipt could not be verified. The uncertain request and its key are retained; you may only retry without changing the details.
general.llamamiento_contacto_validacion: Enter the contact date and time, the reference for its evidence and a dedicated key.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_contacto: Effective contact at {instante} will be recorded with evidence {prueba}. The server will calculate the expiry under the current rules.
general.llamamiento_plazo_no_admitida: Response received after the deadline: the rule does not allow it
general.llamamiento_causa_validacion: Enter the evidence date, document reference and a dedicated key.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_causa: The evidenced justification will be recorded with document {prueba}.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_expiracion: Non-acceptance due to lack of response and call to the next candidate.
general.llamamiento_expiracion_validacion: Tick both checks and use a dedicated key.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_expiracion: Non-acceptance due to lack of response will be recorded and the call to the next candidate will remain pending, under criterion {criterio}.
general.llamamiento_revision_respuesta_rrhh_expi: I confirm that no response is recorded
general.llamamiento_revision_plazo_rrhh_expiraci: I confirm that the response period has expired
